services.desc: There is a lot to enjoy on the water around Wrightsville Beach, but not everyone wants the responsibility of navigating, docking, watching currents, or managing no-wake zones for the day. At Nauti Times Boat Rentals, our captained boat rentals make it easy to relax while an experienced captain handles the boating. Our captain cruises in Wrightsville Beach, NC, are a great option for families, groups, first-time boaters, and visitors who simply want to enjoy the Intracoastal Waterway without worrying about the helm.
